name: microcks-deep-ink
description: Microcks UI v2 design system (Deep Ink): CSS tokens, a copy-paste component registry (React, Angular, HTML), two Web Components, a CLI, a plugin SDK, two Storybooks and a clean-architecture demo.

scripts.build:storybooks: pnpm -C react --filter storybook-react build-storybook && pnpm --filter storybook-angular build-storybook
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @microcks-deep-ink/registry lint && pnpm --filter demo-react lint && pnpm --filter demo-react lint:arch
scripts.a11y: pnpm --filter a11y-tools build && python3 tools/a11y/smoke.py --site site --out a11y-report
